summary: GameStop filed an 8-K disclosing amendments to privately negotiated exchange agreements with existing holders of its 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030 and 2032. The exchange, originally all-stock based on a 35-day VWAP, was amended to settle 73% in shares and 27% in cash. Existing noteholders will receive ~55.5 million shares and ~$358.4 million cash for ~$1.4 billion principal. Closing expected September 3, 2026, subject to customary conditions. The deal reduces debt and dilution overhang; watch share price impact and closing.
